message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features a central, headless figure in a dark suit holding a tilted white document. The figure’s tan hand grips the top edge of the paper, which displays a stylized blue avian logo, a bar chart with orange and light-blue columns, and a circular pie chart. Scattered around the document are various floating symbols: orange and blue rectangles, a white percentage sign, dollar and euro symbols, a line graph on a grid, and the text "IDR" and "61290brl".

The magazine masthead at the top displays "KPK GADUH LAGI" and "BIAYA TINGGI MENEMBUS SENAYAN". Large white text on the left reads "LAPORAN SUNGSANG KEUANGAN GARUDA," followed by a smaller paragraph in Indonesian. A barcode at the bottom left includes the dates "6-12 MEI 2019" and a price of "RP 45.000". The background is a solid teal, framed by a red border on the left. The figure’s suit and the floating objects are rendered with smooth gradients, creating a sense of three-dimensional depth against the flat background.
